newsitem.title: USA: EDS to change dividend policy.
newsitem.headline: EDS to change dividend policy.

text.p: Electronic Data Systems Corp plans to change its dividend policy at the end of this year, chief financial officer Joseph Grant said.

Grant also said EDS expects earnings for the quarter ended in September to be about $0.55 per share, which he noted is in the middle of the range of analyst estimates tracked by First Call. He also said the company expects revenues to be up about 20 percent for the quarter.
EDS' dividend policy has been to give out 30 percent of earnings.

"I believe there will be a change in our dividend practice, but nothing dramatic," Grant said at the Montgomery Securities Investment Conference. The company currently pays a quarterly dividend of $0.15 per share.
